meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, select or create the agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把首个智能体接入私信频道并发出欢迎消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你刚布置好智能体服务,想快速接通私信频道。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your first agent to a DM channel and send a welcome message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just set up an agent service and want to quickly wire it to a DM channel.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会引导操作员选择私信频道、提供用户 ID 和显示名,然后创建第一个 NanoClaw agent,并向该频道发送欢迎私信。
howto.when: 当频道凭据已配置且服务运行中,操作员提出要建立该频道第一个 NanoClaw agent 时。

say.text: 帮我初始化第一个 agent,放在 Discord 上。
在 Telegram 上建立我的第一个 NanoClaw agent。
say.note: 如果还没私信过机器人,会引导你走配对码流程。

say.text: 建一个新 agent,让它给我发条欢迎消息。

howto.what_en: Once enabled, Claude walks the operator through picking a DM channel and providing their channel user ID and display name, then creates the first NanoClaw agent and sends a welcome DM to that channel via the normal delivery path.
howto.when_en: After channel credentials are configured and the service is running, when the operator asks to bring up the first NanoClaw agent for that channel.

say_en.text: Initialize my first agent on Discord.
Set up my first NanoClaw agent on Telegram.
say_en.note: If you haven't DMed the bot yet, it will walk you through the pair-code flow.

say_en.text: Create a new agent and send me a welcome message.
